bounds.domain: One boot/restart owner and two admitted turns. The replacement refinement has distinct outgoing/replacement runtimes, one room, two FIFO callbacks, one shared abort signal and up to three build attempts from running or paused.
bounds.scope: Finite lifecycle safety plus replacement drain progress under weak fairness of callback settlement and publication. The normal replacement refinement does not cover dispose-before-build hosts or post-publication activation failures.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance: an active old-runtime callback eventually settles with success or failure; queued non-cancelled callbacks also settle; a ready publication is eventually scheduled.
This property starts only after a replacement build succeeds and closes admission. It assumes no wall-clock bound or successful database result, and does not require a replacement build to succeed.
No fairness is assumed. Cancelling the queued callback cannot settle an active callback which never returns, so publication can remain pending indefinitely.
